```{r}
#| label: cgi-ancova
#| include: false

# Prepare CGI data for ANCOVA
# CGI is different from other outcomes:
# - cgis_soi (baseline) is the severity at Visit 1
# - cgi_i (Week 16) is the improvement at Visit 3
# We rename cgis to cgi at Visit 1 so fit_cgi_ancova treats it as baseline
data_cgi <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cgis = cgis_soi |> as.numeric(),
    cgi = cgi_i |> as.numeric()
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # At baseline (Visit 1), replace cgi with cgis
    cgi = dplyr::if_else(
      redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)",
      cgis,
      cgi
    )
  )

cgi_var <- c("cgi")
cgi_label <- c("CGI-Improvement")

names(cgi_label) = cgi_var

# fit ANCOVA models using CGI-specific function
cgi_ancova <- lapply(
  cgi_var,
  function(x) fit_cgi_ancova(
    dataset = data_cgi,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = cgi_label[x]
  )
)
names(cgi_ancova) <- cgi_label

# extract tables from fit_cgi_ancova output
cgi_ancova_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(cgi_ancova),
    function(x) {
      cgi_ancova[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cgi-ancova
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "CGI - ANCOVA results showing LS means (95% CI) for baseline CGI-SOI (Severity of Illness)
#|    and full ANCOVA model CGI-I (Improvement), with between-group differences. {data_caption}")

cgi_ancova_ft <- cgi_ancova_summary |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    full_p = "Full Model",
    full_p_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    full_m = "Full Model",
    full_m_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    full_contrast_mean = "Full Model Diff",
    full_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    full_contrast_p = "p-value"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences"),
    colwidths = c(1, 5, 5, 5)
  ) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(1, 6, 11), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

cgi_ancova_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-cgi-ancova-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "CGI - Forest plot showing between-group differences in changes. {data_caption}")

plot_ancova_forest(
  obj = cgi_ancova,
  labels = cgi_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1
)
```
